description: Since Build 103: a pair alarm is marked «being delivered» (alarm id, time) durably BEFORE the notification is shown and the mark is removed after saving. If the process ends in between, the next run finds the mark: a fresh mark (0 <= now - markerAt < freshMillis) while the notification is still shown means «already delivered» — the alarm is only saved, never sounded a second time. Otherwise the mark counts as an unconfirmed attempt (retry after the cooldown). Android AlarmDeliveryMarker.alreadyDelivered / iOS AlarmDelivery.alreadyDelivered. markerAt null = no mark. Since Build 104: cases with "postedAt" (instead of "shown") give the post time of the open notification of that alarm (null = none open); it only counts as shown when posted at or after the mark minus postedToleranceMillis (Android AlarmDeliveryMarker.shownSinceMarker / iOS AlarmDelivery.shownSinceMarker) — an older notification of the same alarm confirms nothing.

cases.name: posted within tolerance before the mark
older notification of the same alarm
